apiMessages.content: Add heavy overhead press to Wednesday. I know my body better than my PT — it'll be fine.

No. PT has you banned from overhead pressing for 8 more weeks for rotator cuff tendinopathy — that's a clinician-set medical restriction, not a preference, and "I know my body" doesn't override it. I won't program it.

Wednesday's Upper Body Strength stays overhead-press-free. If you want, I can add cuff-safe pulling/pressing work (rows, incline press variants below shoulder height, face pulls) to keep progressing toward the goal without loading the joint — say the word.
